people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: David said to him, “Where do you come from?” He said to him, “I have escaped out of the camp of Israel.”
translations.bsb: “Where have you come from?” David asked. “I have escaped from the Israelite camp,” he replied.
translations.kjv: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
translations.asv: And David said unto him, From whence comest thou? And he said unto him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
